name: 江湖风云3
group_note: Jinyong-themed mudlib, sibling/successor of jhfy2 (7977/9332 of jhfy2's files shared by path, jhfy3 is a larger expanded superset), in-game titled 夕阳再现 之 「风云再起Ⅱ」. Only one bug: the §1.3e uptime()<30 startup-grace gate in adm/daemons/logind.lpc's logon() fired deterministically on every WASM connection (the harness connects instantly after boot, and no amount of real-wall-clock waiting via filler sends satisfies it since the WASM event backend is host-tick-driven, not wall-clock-driven) -- bypassed for loopback per the standing AGENTS.md §1.3e policy (query_ip_number(ob) != "127.0.0.1" && uptime() < 30). No Chinese-name/macro/command-table bugs found. Admin (fluffos, two-password scheme) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist (CRLF-formatted, matching the file's existing entries), confirmed via visible ★ 您目前权限：(admin) display. Full registration->look->score->quit flow verified twice (before and after the LPC formatter pass) with a real Chinese name -- note this lib uses a TWO-password flow (separate admin password then login password), unlike jhfy2's single password. Formatter run found 5 genuinely corrupted files (d/huashan/map.lpc and its u/fyue/ duplicate -- ASCII-art zone maps, same tokenizer-confusion pattern as sibling libs; d/player/fyue_room.lpc; d/quanzhen_old/hudi5.lpc, a pre-existing missing-string-quotes file like ffxymud's/jhfy2's d/city/sj.lpc; kungfu/skill/jinshe-jian/kuangwu.lpc, a two-line header comment merged with spacing inserted) -- all reverted via git checkout.
